questions.prompt: Return the sum of all numbers in an array.
questions.reference_solution:
def array_sum(values):
    return sum(values)

questions.prompt: Return the largest number in a non-empty array.
questions.reference_solution:
def array_max(values):
    return max(values)

questions.prompt: Return a new array with the elements in reverse order.
questions.reference_solution:
def reverse_array(values):
    return values[::-1]

questions.prompt: Rotate an array to the right by k positions.
Remove duplicate values from a sorted array, preserving first occurrences.
Merge two sorted arrays into one sorted array.
Return an array where each position is the product of every input value except the value at that position.
questions.reference_solution:
def product_except_self(values):
    result = [1] * len(values)
    prefix = 1
    for i, value in enumerate(values):
        result[i] = prefix
        prefix *= value
    suffix = 1
    for i in range(len(values) - 1, -1, -1):
        result[i] *= suffix
        suffix *= values[i]
    return result

questions.prompt: Return the largest sum of any contiguous subarray; return 0 for an empty array.
Merge overlapping inclusive intervals and return them ordered by start.
Return the index of target in a sorted array, or -1 if it is absent.
Return a string with the characters reversed.
questions.reference_solution:
def reverse_string(text):
    return text[::-1]

questions.prompt: Return True when text reads the same forward and backward, ignoring case.
Count the number of vowels in text, case-insensitively.
questions.reference_solution:
def count_vowels(text):
    return sum(character.lower() in 'aeiou' for character in text)

questions.prompt: Reverse the order of words in a space-separated sentence and use single spaces in the result.
questions.reference_solution:
def reverse_words(text):
    return ' '.join(text.split()[::-1])

questions.prompt: Return True when two strings contain the same letters with the same frequencies.
questions.reference_solution:
def is_anagram(first, second):
    return sorted(first) == sorted(second)

Return the number of occurrences of target in values.
questions.reference_solution:
def count_value(values, target):
    return sum(value == target for value in values)
